description: A short explanation of the renewal and cancellation deadlines for a free trial, with actionable steps to manage it.

segments.text: Your free trial may have a hidden deadline: the renewal or cancellation cutoff. It's not about when you signed up, but when you need to act.
segments.visual_intent: Show a calendar with a highlighted date and a trial card with a 'Renewal/Cancellation Cutoff' label. No motion or text inside the card.

segments.text: Check the trial agreement for renewal terms, price, and the cancellation cutoff date. Make sure automatic renewal is enabled in the terms.
segments.visual_intent: Show a trial agreement card with 'Renewal Terms', 'Price', and 'Cancellation Cutoff' as text cards. No motion or internal labels.

segments.text: Set a reminder before the cutoff. Decide whether to keep or cancel the service. If you cancel, wait for a confirmation from the provider.
segments.visual_intent: Show a calendar with a reminder set before the cutoff date and a trial card with 'Keep' and 'Cancel' as text cards.

segments.on_screen: Follow Wealth Blueprint. Build wealth on purpose.
segments.text: Follow Wealth Blueprint. Build wealth on purpose.
segments.visual_intent: Show the channel's existing CTA text card with the phrase 'Follow Wealth Blueprint. Build wealth on purpose.'

title: Your free trial has a second deadline
